newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Cosmos sets preferred shares issue.
newsitem.headline: Cosmos sets preferred shares issue.

text.p: Shareholders of Cosmos Bottling Corp on Wednesday approved a plan to issue 1.5 billion pesos of convertible preferred shares, the company said.
The shares, to be offered at a price to be decided later, will pay 6.0 percent dividend annually for five years, the company said in a statement.
They can be converted from the third year onward into ordinary shares at a 50 percent discount to average market prices, it said.
Proceeds will be used for re-financing of acquisitions and to fund working capital requirements, Cosmos said. Cosmos is a unit of diversified firm RFM Corp.
